cover.caption: Askeladden går opp i skogen, og han er ikke det minste redd for troll.
cover.alt: Askeladden går opp skogsbilveien med en motorsag og sekken på ryggen. Bak ham, mellom grantrærne, kikker et stort, grått troll fram.
cover.prompt: Askeladden strides up the gravel forest road into the misty spruce forest with an old orange chainsaw in one hand and his backpack on, whistling, not a bit afraid. Behind him, half-hidden among the dark spruces, the Troll leans out from between the trunks, as big as a delivery van, and peers down at him with curious eyes. Rust-orange birch leaves drift through the grey October mist.

characters.name: Askeladden
characters.description: Den yngste sønnen som virker undervurdert, men som møter farer med ro, rask tenkning og frekke bløffer.
characters.look: A small, wiry lad of about sixteen, shorter than most, with a round face, rosy cheeks, bright brown eyes, a button nose, a dark-brown curly mop of hair and a cheeky gap-toothed grin. characters.name: Trollet
characters.description: En gigantisk skogvokter som truer alle som hogger, lett å skremme med det den tror er overmenneskelig styrke, og drevet av stolthet.
characters.look: A huge forest troll as big as a delivery van, grey and bristly all over, with cracked grey skin like an old pine trunk, a shaggy, bristly grey haystack of hair full of twigs and moss, a potato nose, eyes like two wet dark stones in a stream, an enormous mouth that stretches from ear to ear with big square teeth, long dangling arms, hands like upturned tree roots and a huge, round belly. characters.name: Faren
characters.description: Eldre bonde presset av gjeld og regninger, hard i ordene av bekymring, men med et sterkt ønske om å beholde gården.
characters.look: A short, stocky, bow-legged old farmer of about seventy with a stiff back, a broad, weather-beaten, wrinkled face, a big bulbous nose, small eyes under shaggy grey eyebrows and a thick, bristly grey beard cut short and square. He wears reading glasses far down his nose, a patched grey-blue wool cardigan with horn buttons over a checked flannel shirt, brown work trousers with braces and thick grey wool socks.

characters.name: Eldstebror
characters.description: Den eldste sønnen som heller utsetter arbeidet, og som blir skremt fra skogen ved første møte med trollet.
characters.look: A hulking, broad-shouldered young man of about twenty-two with a thick neck, a broad, flat face, a crooked nose, small pale-blue eyes, heavy black eyebrows and short, bristly black hair cropped close to his head. He wears a shaggy, sheepskin-lined sleeveless vest over a grey hoodie, baggy brown cargo trousers and heavy black boots.

characters.name: Mellombror
characters.description: Den mellomste sønnen, som skal starte et enda bedre firma enn broren, men som også slipper saga og løper fra trollet.
characters.look: A thin, jittery young man of about twenty with a long neck, a narrow face, a long pointed nose, big worried eyes and frizzy light-brown hair. On his head sits a long, floppy, bright-yellow knitted beanie with a blue tassel. He wears a baggy blue hoodie, patched grey tracksuit trousers and wooden clogs.

places.name: the Old Spruce
places.look: A steep, dark stand of old spruce on a hillside above a small farm: in the middle, one huge old spruce with long grey beards of lichen hanging from its branches, surrounded by mossy boulders, ferns and a few rust-orange birches, with a gravel forest road and a red barrier below. Grey October mist hangs between the trunks.
